name: CLOTRIMAZOLE/ DEXAMETHASONE 1GR/0.04GR CREAM 30 GR
description: It relieves inflammation (swelling, heat, redness, and pain) and is used to treat certain forms of arthritis; skin, blood, kidney, eye, thyroid, and bowel disorders (e.g., colitis); severe allergies; and asthma.
